messages:
Anya Patel: heads up — quantized 4-bit reranker build (q4) passed unit tests but eval on multilingual anchor shows MRR drop on es/fr short queries. sharing quick numbers.
Miguel Torres: can you paste the exact eval command and seed? also which tokenizer/encoding was used for the q4 build?
Anya Patel: eval cmd: `python eval_rerank.py --model /models/rerank-q4 --dataset anchor_multilang_v2 --split dev --seed 42 --batch 64 --scoring pairwise`
Anya Patel: baseline fp16 MRR@10: 0.412, q4 MRR@10: 0.378
Anya Patel: NDCG@10 baseline: 0.495, q4: 0.483
Samir Gupta: that's non-trivial for short-span queries. what's the query length distribution? tokenization often bites us here.
Anya Patel: median query tokens (es)=3, docs median tokens=80. candidate ordering upstream looks stable from trace.
Miguel Torres: historically we've seen tokenizer/merge mismatches cause subtle rank shifts. were both runs using the same spm/vocab?
Anya Patel: both reference spm v1, but noticed the q4 runner truncates inputs at 128 tokens while fp16 run used 512. oops.
Heidi Zhao: truncation could hurt long docs, but curious that short queries show MRR drop — maybe scoring dynamics changed after quant.
Samir Gupta: try isolating: feed fp16 logits into q4 downstream scoring (i.e., same postproc) to separate kernel/runtime vs quant noise.
Anya Patel: did a quick swap: when using fp16 logits into q4 scoring path gap reduced to ~0.01 MRR. looks like scoring/runtime path differences matter.
Anya Patel: attached smoke logs snippet: ```
fp16 top1 avg_score: 3.12
q4 top1 avg_score: 2.98
score_std_diff: 0.14
```
Miguel Torres: interesting — could be calibration shift from PTQ. what calibration dataset did you use?
Anya Patel: used default 1k random samples from en-docs (not multilingual).
Samir Gupta: that might explain language skew. PTQ calibration on en-only can bias logits for es/fr. try multilingual calibration set.
Anya Patel: queued a multilingual calibration run (es/fr/en samples) and a seed sweep (42,123,7). will compare.
devex-bot: scheduled canary: rerank-q4-canary on dev-cluster tomorrow 04:00 UTC (job id 87321) :white_check_mark:
Miguel Torres: next steps checklist: 1) tokenizer parity test 2) remove/truncate parity (128 vs 512) 3) multilingual PTQ calibration 4) run seed sweep and report NDCG/MRR deltas by language slice
Anya Patel: will run those today and upload diffs + per-slice CSVs here. linking when ready.
eva-eval: fyi I flagged candidate slicing edge-case in anchor_multilang_v2 yesterday — might overlap with truncation.
Anya Patel: thanks @eva-eval — linking ticket and will include candidate-slicing check in the run.
Samir Gupta: if the gap persists after parity + multilingual calibration, try hybrid quant (q4 tokens but keep top layers fp16) or KL-based bias correction.
Miguel Torres: good plan. keep short updates here, if we confirm a regression we'll block the q4 rollout for enterprise channels. :thumbsup:
